sources.entry: Teampass - Password manager dedicated for managing passwords in a collaborative way. One symmetric key is used to encrypt all shared/team passwords and stored server side in a file and the database. works on any server Apache, MySQL and PHP. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Teampass is a self-hosted, collaborative password manager for teams, built on PHP and MySQL/MariaDB, with folder-level access control and encrypted shared credentials.
summary.what_it_does: Teampass is a credential vault run on your own PHP/MySQL server, with no hosted account required. It provides folders with unlimited nesting and per-folder password complexity rules, plus roles and per-user overrides controlling read, write, no-edit and no-delete rights. Secrets are described as encrypted with AES-256-GCM under per-object keys, with per-user RSA-wrapped key copies so removing an account revokes access. Authentication options include local accounts, LDAP/AD with nested groups, OAuth2/SSO, TOTP, Duo, YubiKey and AGSES MFA. The README also lists a REST API with JWT auth, a browser extension, import from Bitwarden, LastPass, 1Password, KeePassXC and CSV, and export to CSV, PDF and an encrypted offline HTML vault. Governance features include audit trails, access recertification campaigns, compliance reports and password expiry reminders.
use_cases: share team passwords without using chat or spreadsheets
self-host a password vault for a homelab or small team
control which users can see which credentials via folders and roles
enterprise access reviews and compliance evidence for audits
migrate passwords in from Bitwarden, LastPass, 1Password or KeePassXC
send one-time secrets to clients or contractors
how_to_run: Alternatively, install bare metal on a PHP 8.2+ and MySQL 5.7+ or MariaDB 10.7+ server following the official installation guide
notable: Per-user RSA-wrapped object keys so account removal revokes access
Authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption with PBKDF2-SHA256 key derivation (600,000 iterations)
Personal folders that administrators cannot read
Have I Been Pwned checks without sending passwords
caveats: Commercial browser extension (Pro) is paid, from €49/year with a 30-day trial, and professional services are quoted per engagement
Requires a specific PHP extension set (openssl, mysqli, gmp, bcmath, etc.), with ldap needed for LDAP/AD
Development and maintenance described as largely by one person; project is funded by sponsorship
keywords: keep team passwords out of chat
